draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks for letting me know you're still deciding whether Wrenfield is the right fit — happy to give you the week, and no pressure from me in the meantime.

One thing that often helps teams evaluate: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so seeing one real workflow in place usually makes the call clearer. If it's useful, I can help you set up that one next step whenever you're ready — just reply and I'll pick it up from there.

Best,
Nadia
